snippet.title: [PS3 Archive] - G1 Jockey 4 - Part 2 - [Story Mode] Mock Races and Graduation
snippet.description:
Continuing on with more G1 Jockey 4 on the Playstation 3.

This time we start the story mode and do some character customizing, Mock Races, and Graduate from our school.

Note: If this is Easy Mode I am screwed... The amount of character saying they are proud of me and have heard great things about me almost feels like sarcasm based on my performances D: This may just be the beginning of my one of stint as a failed Jockey.
